kicker: BLACK FRIDAY HALF DAY · STOCKS CLOSE 1:00PM, BONDS 2:00PM ET · MORNING BRIEF
headline: Futures up 1.7% into the half day, memory chips lead.
lede: S&P futures were +1.73% and Nasdaq 100 futures +2.35% at 5:43am. Sandisk, Micron and WDC are up 6% to 11% premarket after Kospi rose 4.3% and the Nikkei 2.1%.
drivers: Premarket 6:47am: Sandisk +11.1%, Seagate +7.2%, WDC +7.0%, Micron +6.6%, AMD +4.8%, Nvidia +3.9%. Forbes calls it a rebound in battered AI shares after weeks of AI and rate worries.
Kospi +4.34%, Nikkei +2.11%, Hang Seng +2.1%, Shanghai +3.7%. In Tokyo, Lasertec +10%, Kioxia +8.9%, Advantest +7.1%, Tokyo Electron +4.4%.
Brent $97.62, WTI $86.05 (AP). Yahoo says Brent rose after Houthi attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure. OPEC+ meets Sunday.
CME FedWatch: 98.9% odds of a 25bp hike Dec 9 (Forbes). The 10 year is down to about 4.84% (Yahoo). Thin half day books can swing both ways.
picks: S&P perps 7,288, +1.4% vs Wed close and +0.8% since Thu 4pm. A bit below the 7,306 seen at 11:15pm Thu.
Premarket: Sandisk +11.1%, Seagate +7.2%, WDC +7.0%, Micron +6.6%, AMD +4.8%, Intel +4.8%, Nvidia +3.9%. Nasdaq futures +2.4%, S&P +1.8%.
Gold futures +3.9% to $3,704.50 and the 10 year yield near 4.85% (Yahoo quotes). Silver perp +5% since Thu 4pm.
CME FedWatch prices a 98.9% chance of a 25bp hike on Dec 9 (Forbes). Already known.
Stoxx 600 +1% to 643.52, best day since mid May. Tech +2.6% led by ASML, ASM International and Infineon; miners +4%.
Brent +1.1% to $97.62, WTI +2.8% to $86.05 (AP). Yahoo cites Houthi attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure.
Closes: Kospi +4.34% to 4,915.68, Nikkei +2.11% to 58,711.11, Hang Seng +2.2%, Shanghai +3.7%, Taiex +0.4%. China signaled stronger market support (AP).
Tokyo core CPI 2.9% in Nov vs 3.0% forecast, up from 2.6%. Energy +9.5%. Markets still price about 74% odds of a BOJ hike Dec 18.
Trump calls the revised Q3 GDP of 4.3% (from 3.4%) fake and asks for an investigation (Yahoo).
FT: Nvidia tells Dell and Supermicro to stop server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia under new US export curbs. Known.
Wed close: S&P 7,182.78 (−0.25%) after a 3.2% intraday drop. See the Wed recap tab.
means: Perps near 7,288 sit above 7,201, the bull trigger, and above 7,267, the top of today's ±1.17% implied move from Wednesday. The gap already uses up the move options priced.
Holding above 7,201 after 9:30am keeps the rebound; back under it puts the 7,060 to 7,200 range in play. A full gap fill is Wednesday's 7,183 close.
Memory names lead. If Sandisk, Micron and WDC hold their premarket gains into the open, the move has breadth inside chips.
Risks stay outside stocks: Brent near $98, a Dec 9 hike priced near 99%, and a 1:00pm close with thin books.
calendar: Advance goods trade, retail inventories (Oct, prior +0.4%) and wholesale inventories (Oct, prior +0.7%)
Cash open vs 7,201 trigger and 7,267 implied move top
ISM manufacturing, JOLTS, Fed's Bowman. Huang House interview. Marvell earnings
